title: Cardinality of finite lists
statement: Let $X$ be any set. Write $\operatorname{List}(X)=\coprod_{n\in\mathbf N}X^n$ for the set of finite ordered lists of elements of $X$, including the empty list; the displayed coproduct is the colimit in sets of the discrete diagram $n\mapsto X^n$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then $|\operatorname{List}(X)|\leq\max(\aleph_0,|X|)$.
